articles.headline: World's weirdest soccer leagues: 8 champions? Points for losing?
articles.description: What happens when leagues shun the traditional round-robin format? Here's some of the weird and wonderful ways titles are won around the world.

articles.headline: Sergio Agüero record broken by 14-year-old in Argentina
articles.description: Aged 14 years and 29 days, Deportivo Riestra midfielder Mateo Apolonio shattered a historic record on Thursday, becoming the youngest player ever to appear in Argentina's First Division.

images.name: Mateo Apolonio [1296x729]
images.caption: Mateo Apolonio became the youngest player in the history of Argentina's top division on Thursday.

articles.headline: River Plate coach Gallardo to leave in December after 8 years
articles.description: Marcelo Gallardo will leave River Plate when his contract ends in December after more than eight years at the club.

images.name: Marcelo Gallardo River Plate [1296x729]

articles.headline: Copa Argentina tie between Racing and Mitre postponed after clashes
articles.description: Decision followed violent scenes on Monday when rival members of Racing's "Barra Brava" ultras group fought gun battles near their home stadium.

articles.headline: Sport Club Pacifico defender poked Estudiantes players with needle
articles.description: Sport Club Pacifico defender Federico Allende has revealed that he used a needle to poke the strikers of top-division club Estudiantes.

articles.headline: Steward and players clash after Copa Argentina tie at Central Norte
articles.description: The incident happened in the aftermath of Central Norte progressing on aggregate despite a 1-0 defeat.
